payload.tension: The passage states freedom becomes servanthood across changing audiences. For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more. Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
